# Preserve/replace with transform implementing 2x2 tile reflection completion, inferred from demonstrated symmetry. Existing prior code is present; replace by writing final implementation.
path='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u024/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3d7b5c54.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate separator rows/columns by their uniform nonzero color.
    sep = next(v for v in range(1, 10) if all(x == v for x in grid[0]) or all(row and all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid if all(x == v for x in row)))
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == sep for x in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]
    rstarts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in rows]
    rends = rows + [h]
    cstarts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in cols]
    cends = cols + [w]
    rb = [(a, b) for a, b in zip(rstarts, rends) if b > a]
    cb = [(a, b) for a, b in zip(cstarts, cends) if b > a]
    # Each 2x2 block of tiles is completed by reflections across its tile boundaries.
    for ri in range(0, len(rb) - 1, 2):
        ra, rz = rb[ri]
        rb0, rbz = rb[ri + 1]
        nr = min(rz - ra, rbz - rb0)
        for ci in range(0, len(cb) - 1, 2):
            ca, cz = cb[ci]
            cc, ccz = cb[ci + 1]
            nc = min(cz - ca, ccz - cc)
            tiles = [(ra, ca, 0, 0), (ra, cc, 0, 1), (rb0, ca, 1, 0), (rb0, cc, 1, 1)]
            # For every nonempty tile, reflect its pixels into the other three tiles.
            sources = [(y, x, grid[sy + y][sx + x]) for sy, sx, _, _ in tiles for y in range(nr) for x in range(nc) if grid[sy + y][sx + x] not in (0, sep)]
            for sy, sx, dy, dx in tiles:
                for y, x, v in sources:
                    ty = y if dy == 0 else nr - 1 - y
                    tx = x if dx == 0 else nc - 1 - x
                    out[sy + ty][sx + tx] = v
    return out
'''
